title: Venezuelan Peanut Casserole
description: A creamy and rich dish from Venezuela, perfect for a comforting meal. With peanuts as the main ingredient, this casserole is a twist on traditional desserts.
instructions: Grease the casserole dish with veggie oil.
In a large bowl, mix the roasted peanuts, honey, and flour until well combined.
Pour the mixture into the prepared casserole dish.
Bake for 25-30 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the casserole is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
